comments.author: @SkonrokkenTV
comments.text: My only problem with food influencers like Wiens, who is very good, they can't possibly eat all they order. So most of what he orders for his channel goes in the bin. Which I'm not cool with, mother and siblings and grandparents grew up in Norway in WWII when food was scarce. I still hate throwing out food, never go there if I can help it. Maybe another culture, but throwing out food and not eating all on your plate seems very wrong. Never throw out food unless it's obviously old or unsafe. So a lot of food went into the bin to make this video. Not cool with that. I should know worked in top restaurants as a chef and we threw out tons. See it now as a disgrace. At Quay we threw out all the pastries the next day to make from scratch, tens of kilos, just so it was at a Michelin level and made fresh every day. Etc.
